set system host-name DeviceC.explanation: Configure the host name of the device.

parameters.name: hostname

set interfaces ge-1/0/1 unit 0 family in.explanation: Configure IPv4 addresses for interfaces and subnet masks.

parameters.name: unit

parameters.name: unit

parameters.name: ip-address

set protocols bgp group external type ex.command: set protocols bgp group external type external
set protocols bgp group external type ex.explanation: Configure the type of BGP group to be external.

parameters.name: type
parameters.explanation: Type of BGP group, e.g. external.

set protocols bgp group external local-a.explanation: Configure the local address of the BGP group.

parameters.name: local-address

set protocols bgp group external peer-as.command: set protocols bgp group external peer-as 100

parameters.name: export
